content: Dhruv followed up on his expired auto policy, requesting details on coverage and deductible for the 5% discount plan. Sunita responded that the plan includes comprehensive and collision coverage with a $500 deductible, attached a brochure, and asked if Dhruv had further questions or wanted to proceed.

action_items: Dhruv to review the attached brochure and decide whether to proceed with the new policy
Sunita to await Dhruv's confirmation or further questions
